activity_summary: Mistress Ansell had sent for Yaxley. He shaved the beard close, once, for the chair, and he did not draw anything. You asked him to leave enough for a stage beard to sit over. Nobody named a price on the stair. The October tooth was mentioned as already paid, and it was not charged again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked for close, once, and for no sum on the stair.

entities.name: Barnaby Yaxley
entities.context: Shaved the beard and did not name a price.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Had sent for him, and forbade the bargaining.

facets.activity: Had Yaxley shave the beard close

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Close, then. Once. I am not here to have anything drawn.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: And you will not undertake a price on my stair.

quotes.speaker: barnaby_yaxley
quotes.text: A beard is not a tooth, and I am not keeping this one in a box.
